caption:
147,666 ratings on a $9.98 shower liner. That number doesn't happen by accident.

Most shower curtain liners get a handful of reviews and disappear. This one is a 72x72 inch clear PEVA liner, non-toxic, priced under $10, and it has racked up nearly 150,000 ratings at 4.6 stars. That kind of volume usually means it's a repeat purchase across a lot of bathrooms, not a one-off impulse buy.

It's a straightforward waterproof liner made from PEVA, sized for a standard 72x72 tub or shower, meant to sit behind your main curtain and keep water in. At 4.6 stars across 147,666 reviews, the rating has held steady at scale, which is a harder bar to clear than a product with a few dozen reviews.

If your bathroom needs a basic, clear waterproof liner without overthinking it, this is a low-risk pick at $9.98.
